name: astrok
description: Astro, Solid 2 and OKF framework with optional trusted hypermedia

scripts.validate:okf: npm run build --workspace @astrokjs/okf && node scripts/validate-okf.mjs knowledge --strict && node scripts/validate-okf.mjs examples/graph/knowledge --strict && node scripts/validate-okf.mjs examples/workspace/knowledge --strict
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @astrokjs/example-workspace
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @astrokjs/example-workspace
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check && npm run build:docs && npm run test:docs:browser && npm run verify:astrok
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @astrokjs/theme && npm run build --workspace @astrokjs/okf && npm run build --workspace @astrokjs/astro && npm run build --workspace @astrokjs/runtime
scripts.verify:astrok: npm run build:packages && npm run validate:okf && npm run test:runtime && node --test tests/packages.test.mjs && npm run check --workspace @astrokjs/example-workspace && npm run build --workspace @astrokjs/example-workspace && npm run test:browser && npm run verify:packages
